comment: The campaign-mode name key (integrations listmonk/CAMPAIGN-MODE-SPEC D3, I1): every run of U+0020, U+0009, U+000A, U+000D, U+000C, U+000B, U+00A0 becomes one U+0020, one leading and one trailing U+0020 are removed, then the string is lower-cased; no other character is touched (U+2003 is kept, also at the end). Latin-1 accents only. Read by frontend/src/campaignGroups.test.mjs (campaignGroups.mjs::nameKey, defined in nameKey.mjs) and by cmd/campaign_groups_db_test.go (core.NameKeySQL through Postgres) -- change both and this file together.
